Rejection 2 (squash inertness, PR #4213 head 9e484e252 to 0410a89f0): merged_delivery_commits now recognises merge_ancestry via exact git ancestry, tried first and needing no network, and squash_pr_metadata via authoritative GitHub PR metadata requiring exactly one merged PR whose headRefOid equals the worker delivery head, state MERGED, baseRefName the expected integration branch, mergedAt at or after dispatch, and a mergeCommit that is an ancestor of the base and itself carries the Task-ID trailer dated at or after dispatch. Branch name is only the lookup key; task id alone never implies a squash; provider prose and pr_url are never consulted and pr_url is recorded with pr_url_is_authoritative false. Every lookup failure, metadata disagreement, duplicate same-head record and git error fails closed.
